Source & coverage

All 419 references from the survey, supplemented by papers already cited across GameMap. Duplicate publications are merged.

457 papers and reports; 26 books, product pages, and other related sources. The default list shows academic research and technical reports.

Roles follow the survey index and cited sections, with editorial classification where needed. This is a bibliographic reading map; inclusion does not imply independent reproduction, peer review, or permission to reuse code.

Code and demo labels follow author pages, repository contents, and stated licenses. A public repository without an established open-source license is labeled separately. Partial tools, release placeholders, and videos are not treated as complete runnable systems or interactive demos.

No official code found describes this review, not proof that code is closed. Demo access may require an account, hardware, paid APIs, or local setup; each detail page records the conditions and evidence.
